Crawford-Hernandez Medical Group
Re: Rhonda Spencer (DOB 02/06/1947)

March 13, 2025

Today, I saw Rhonda Spencer for her follow-up regarding her Barrett's esophagus. Her blood pressure was 135/90, and her weight was 160 pounds. Mrs. Spencer is doing well overall. She has been compliant with her management plan, which includes regular monitoring of her condition. She reports no new symptoms or issues with her esophagus.

On examination, her physical condition was normal except for the known Barrett's esophagus. She continues to take ergocalciferol 50000 IU for her vitamin D deficiency, which is well-controlled. There are no signs of progression of her esophageal dysplasia. 

May 17, 2024

I last saw Rhonda Spencer on May 17, 2024, for her regular follow-up regarding Barrett's esophagus. Her blood pressure was 129/89, and she weighed 156 pounds. Mrs. Spencer continues to do well. There have been no new symptoms, and she reports feeling stable.

Her physical examination was unremarkable except for the known condition of Barrett's esophagus with high dysplasia. She continues to take ergocalciferol 50000 IU, which has effectively managed her vitamin D deficiency. We discussed the importance of her follow-up endoscopies and she is compliant with the recommended schedule.

July 22, 2023

On July 22, 2023, Rhonda Spencer came for her ankle sprain. Her blood pressure at that time was 121/87, and she weighed 161 pounds. She was evaluated and treated for the sprain. In addition, we reviewed her known medical conditions, including Barrett's esophagus with high dysplasia and vitamin D deficiency.

Mrs. Spencer's physical examination the ankle showed no signs of ongoing issues, and she was advised on rest and rehabilitation exercises. We continued her on ergocalciferol 50000 IU for her vitamin D deficiency. She reported no complications from her chronic conditions.

Social History

Mrs. social history includes moderate alcohol consumption, approximately two drinks per week. There is no history of smoking, and she maintains a generally healthy lifestyle.

Dr. Paul Navarro
